label: Task-4
title: Revert ADR-001 to Jekyll: stakeholder changed preference
description: Stakeholder has reversed the Hugo decision. Use Jekyll instead for the Journalist GitHub Pages news site. Reason: native GitHub Pages support means zero custom CI needed for builds _ GitHub handles it automatically. This simplifies the architecture significantly. ADR-001 originally recommended Jekyll, then Task-2 was created to revise for Hugo based on the interview. This task supersedes Task-2. Update ADR-001 status to Accepted with Jekyll as the final choice. Close Task-2 as superseded.
